prompt: We're building a recommendation system and want to model our user-item interaction graph. It has about 5 million users, 2 million items, and 800 million interactions. I want to compute betweenness centrality and run community detection on this thing. Was planning to use NetworkX. Will that work?
assertions: Output redirects away from NetworkX for this scale (5M nodes, 800M edges)
Output recommends NetworKit, cuGraph, or graph-tool as appropriate large-scale alternatives
Output warns that exact betweenness centrality is computationally infeasible at this scale (O(VE) or O(V*E))
Output mentions approximate betweenness (sampling-based) as a practical alternative
Output provides specific library recommendations with rationale (e.g., NetworKit for parallel CPU, cuGraph for GPU)
